info.name: Query archived stats for a date range.

params.name: user
params.description: Account user id, for sessionless (token) access.

params.name: token
params.description: Read-only API token for sessionless access (paired with user).

params.name: demo
params.description: Set to 1 to query the public demo account.

items.docs: Returns aggregated, archived visit data for the authenticated account over a date range as JSON. Authentication is by session cookie or by a user + token pair (sessionless, read-only). When demo=1 the magic demo account is queried instead.

info.name: Stream live and archived stats (Server-Sent Events).

params.name: utcoffset
params.description: Client UTC offset for day/hour bucketing.

params.name: user
params.description: Account user id, for sessionless (token) access.

params.name: token
params.description: Read-only API token for sessionless access (paired with user).

params.name: demo
params.description: Set to a non-empty value to stream the public demo account.

items.docs: Opens a text/event-stream (Server-Sent Events) connection that pushes an initial archive payload and then live "dump" payloads (per-site counts, logs, and aggregated visits) as new visits arrive. Authenticated by session cookie, by user + token (sessionless), or via demo. This is the data feed the dashboard UI consumes; it is one-way HTTP streaming, not WebSocket.
